item.title: Senate Passes Electoral Act Amendment, Rejects Real-Time Transmission of Results
item.description: Senate passes Electoral Act amendment, keeping electronic result transmission but rejecting real-time reporting.

item.title: Kabir: Nigeria In Political Mess Because We Refused To Build Ideological Parties
item.description: APC chieftain, Shitu Mohammed Kabir, says Nigeria’s refusal to adopt proportional representation has created winner-takes-all desperation.

item.title: IMF Projects Nigeria To Overtake Algeria As Africa’s Third-Largest Economy By 2026
item.description: IMF has projected that Nigeria may become Africa’s third-largest economy with GDP at $334bn in 2026.

item.title: Kolawole: Nigeria’s Insecurity Persists Because We Lack Actionable Intelligence, Not Firepower
item.description: Rear Admiral Dolapo Kolawole (rtd), former Director of Operations, Naval Headquarters, says Nigeria’s insecurity persists due to intelligence gaps, not lack of firepower.

item.title: Nigeria Says US Troops In Country Limited To Training, Intelligence Support
item.description: Federal government says US military personnel in Nigeria are non-combat advisers providing intelligence and training support at its request.

item.title: Shettima Launches South-East Vision 2050, Calls Region Pillar Of Nigeria’s Economic Future
item.description: Vice president Shettima has unveiled a 25-year blueprint for the south-east, as regional leaders push integration and long-term development.

item.title: Pat Utomi: Nigeria’s Political Decline Began In 1999 When Undesirables Took Over Power
item.description: Political economist Pat Utomi says post-military transition sidelined ideas, enabling self-interest, hate politics and elite capture of Nigeria's democracy.

item.title: Nigeria Pledges Balance Between Innovation And Data Privacy Protection
item.description: NDPC says Nigeria is prioritising innovation while strengthening safeguards to protect privacy amid rapid adoption of emerging technologies.

item.title: IGP Egbetokun Says Police–Capital Market Partnership Boosts Investor Confidence
item.description: IGP Egbetokun says deeper collaboration with market regulators will enhance transparency, curb misconduct and strengthen confidence in Nigeria’s capital market.

item.title: Kwara Governor AbdulRazaq Says Terrorists Killed 75 In Kwara For Rejecting ‘Strange Doctrines’
item.description: Kwara governor AbdulRazaq says 75 residents were killed in Woro jihadist attacks, with mass burials held and security taskforce activated.
